desc: 白底瓶盒同框起势，青蓝大字屏承接，痛点分屏到留空背书与收口
name: 青蓝瓶盒同框清爽洗护款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，瓶身与外盒同框交代真实到手形态
主图一秒法则，用青蓝底大字块把首要利益点一句话说清
shots.textZone: 顶部中央大字区，仅承载「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 放大有日常头皮不适与形象顾虑的人群痛点，引发代入
shots.textZone: 底部青蓝横幅条，仅承载「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏对照把困扰状态与产品方案并置，替代口头主张
shots.textZone: 右栏上方主张位，仅承载「{selling_point_3}」

shots.intent: 以中央产品加六向细线标注的信息图结构，一次交代多个利益点位置
shots.textZone: 左右各三条细线标注位，仅承载「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」与「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 微距证明封口与瓶肩做工，消除材质与泄漏疑虑
三行适配清单让人对号入座自选，替代口头适用范围主张
复刻外盒背面表格式信息结构但全部留空，满足看说明的心理需求又不编造内容
shots.textZone: 中部空表格外框与空参数行，不出字

shots.intent: 用留空印章框与指示条承接信任信息位，降风险但不编造资质
shots.textZone: 上方一行主张位，仅承载「{selling_point_4}」；三枚印章框留空

shots.intent: 收口促单，瓶盒成组同框加留空按钮位承接行动指令
shots.textZone: 上方主张位与下方按钮条，仅承载「{selling_point_5}」与「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF and pale ice #E8F4FA for packshots and spec screens, alternating with saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB type panels carrying one soft radial glow
style.direction: clean pharmacy-shelf haircare commerce with bold type panels
style.iconSystem: hairline rules, empty seal frames and thin-line marks only, single accent color, no filled badges
style.lightingSystem: bright even cool studio light, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows only, one sweeping highlight on macro, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean haircare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale ice #E8F4FA, saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB panel fields and one marigold accent #F5A623; cool neutral studio tone; bright even key light from the front with soft fill and soft contact shadows only, one subtle radial glow behind products on cyan panels; matte white and pale ice surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif oversized headline blocks, one line per panel; hairline rules, empty seal frames and thin-line icons, no filled badges; product unit shown with its carton at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle and unchanging scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no readable brand marks or invented numbers.
noDrift: no readable brand marks or invented numbers
style.presentationRules: unit and its carton always displayed together at the same slight 3/4 or straight-on scale and placement, label facing the lens, never cropped
style.surfaceSystem: matte white seamless sweep #FFFFFF and matte pale ice board #E8F4FA, no reflective tabletop
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in oversized headline blocks, one line only per panel
